verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's core function is AI-generated insights and suggestions from the user's own code and PR data, delivered inside the product. The docs cover multi-model review feedback, generated PR summaries and walkthroughs, Change Stack findings with conversational chat, CI-failure fix suggestions, AI-ranked Triage queues and Slack-agent investigation. Hands-on users praise the reviews, though one team reported verbosity and false positives. That is a quality concern, not a contradiction of the capability. missing for 10: evidence that the analytics dashboard surfaces AI-generated insights rather than only metrics, and consistent independent corroboration of suggestion accuracy.
